# Villa Pomona Bled

> Villa Pomona is a luxury villa in Bled, Slovenia with three bedrooms, a pool house, swimming pool, sauna, garden, and private parking.

## Official website

- English: https://villa-pomona-bled.com/
- Slovenian: https://villa-pomona-bled.com/sl/
- German: https://villa-pomona-bled.com/de/
- Sitemap: https://villa-pomona-bled.com/sitemap.xml

## Accommodation facts

- Name: Villa Pomona
- Type: Luxury villa rental / individual rooms and pool house
- Location: Crtomirova ulica 2, 4260 Bled, Slovenia
- Capacity: Up to 8 guests for the entire villa
- Accommodation: Three bedrooms, pool house, and entire-villa option
- Facilities: Swimming pool, pool house, sauna, garden, terrace, lounge library, kitchen, Wi-Fi, air conditioning, washing machine, and private parking for up to 5 vehicles
- Pool: Seasonal and typically open from May to September, weather permitting; not heated
- Check-in: From 15:00
- Check-out: By 10:00
- Nearby: Lake Bled and central Bled
- Languages: English, Slovenian, and German pages are available
